# Alternatives to ChatOn

Updated November 25, 2026 · prices from the US App Store

ChatOn is a popular all-in-one AI app. If you want a different set of models, a monthly plan or an on-device model, here are the alternatives, with what their own listings say.

## The options

1. **[ChatGPT](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6448311069)** (OpenAI): best for OpenAI's own app. The original, with a generous free tier and OpenAI's newest features. *Price (US): ChatGPT Go $8.00, ChatGPT Plus $19.99, ChatGPT Pro from $100 (in-app purchase list); Plus is $20 a month on OpenAI's site (3 November 2026).*

2. **[Genie (Chatbot AI Assistant)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1658377526)** (AppNation): best for research and images. Deep Search reports, image editing and voice chat. *Price (US): Weekly Unlimited $7.99, other weekly plans $8.99 to $12.99, yearly $39.99 and $99.99 (in-app purchase list); supports Family Sharing.*

3. **[Nova](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1669007652)** (ScaleUp): best for a guided app. Scan-and-solve, Word and Excel files, voice mode. *Price (US): 1 Week Chatbot Pro $4.99 to $7.99, Nova Premium $9.99, 1 Year Chatbot Pro $39.99 and $59.99 (in-app purchase list).*

4. **[ChatNow](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1667518571)** (Tappz): best for the most models. More than 30 models including video. *Price (US): AI Plus $6.99, ChatNow Plus $19.99, yearly plans $49.99 to $79.99, credit packs (in-app purchase list); supports Family Sharing; needs iOS 26.*

5. **[Omnimo](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891)** (made by the team behind this site): best for several makers' models in one chat. GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and more, switchable mid-chat, with Apple Intelligence free on the device and no account. *Price (US): free to start; $6.99 a week (3-day free trial), $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year (1-week free trial). US prices; the app shows the price for your country.*

Ratings, prices and features: each app's US App Store listing and list of in-app purchases, read 25 November 2026. The App Store lists in-app purchases without their billing period; where a listing doesn't say, neither do we.

## How we chose

We list apps we have looked at closely, with what their own listings say. We make Omnimo, so it is on every list; we have tried to say plainly when another app is the better choice.

## Questions

### Is there a ChatOn alternative with a monthly plan?

Yes. Omnimo Pro has a monthly plan at $9.99 in the US, besides $6.99 a week and $39.99 a year. ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity also sell monthly plans.

### Which ChatOn alternative lets me choose the model?

Omnimo, ChatNow, Poe and Fello AI all let you pick the model by name.
